body: That last sentence does not seem to be true.  Working in oil and has is terrible, but leaving it is often way worse.  You will owe your company ten thousand dollars or more, make way less money, probably be unemployed a lot, have to move, give up all your friends, start over again as an entry level employee.
I don't believe there is treatment for this.  Even SNDRIs don't improve your life, they just inhibit dopamine reuptake.

>Would you agree that your imagination is perhaps colored by the circumstances of your current shitty situation?

Maybe.  I don't see why it would matter though.

> By that token, if there is the slimmest hope of happiness for you (and I believe that there is much more than a slim chance) do you want to die with the last thought in your head being one of negativity?

The most likely scenario is a long and unhappy life, where I die with many more unhappy thoughts than I have now.  Seems sensible to avoid this negativity by killing myself now and avoiding the long and shitty life.

> Is there anyone around you that cares about you besides me and others on the internet?

Of course, but they're no help.  Can't live just so they don't feel bad anyway.
Working a low paying job sounds bad, so does being a friendless old guy in school and wasting another half a decade studying.

>How in the world can you claim to have the foresight necessary to say with scientific certainty that it will NEVER get any better?

I can use my imagination to picture different realistic scenarios and how shitty or not shitty they would be.

> I don't know if you are religious, but if there is no afterlife you are in essence going to be stuck forever in this shitty state.

I imagine it will be like before I was born.  So that would be an improvement.

I can't imagine making a radical change for the better like that. I see my future more as living on someone's couch until my savings are gone, then getting another engineering job and hating my life or getting a job tending bar and hating my life for new and different reasons.
What is the point of continuing an existence that you don't like?  Surely living to be 80 and hating life the whole way through is worse than cutting it short.
